05819 `Aziyza' {az-ee-zaw'}

源自 05756; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Aziza 1; 1

亞西撒 = "強壯"
1) 以斯拉時代平信徒薩土家族的一員, 他曾娶了一外邦女子為妻 (#拉 10:27|)

05819 `Aziyza' {az-ee-zaw'}

from 05756;; n pr m

AV - Aziza 1; 1

Aziza = "strong"
1) a layman of the family of Zattu who took a foreign wife in the
   time of Ezra
